label: Use Restriction Type
description: The nature of what a Use Restriction limits grant funds to (or from) -- distinct from Fund's own restriction-type scheme, which describes a Fund's accounting restriction status rather than the specific nature of a grant term's use restriction. Values do not all carry identical legal significance.

values.label: General Purpose
values.definition: Not restricted beyond the grantee's general mission.

values.label: Specific Project
values.definition: Restricted to a named project.

values.label: Specific Program
values.definition: Restricted to a named program.

values.label: Specific Activity
values.definition: Restricted to a named activity.

values.label: Specific Population
values.definition: Restricted to serving a named population.

values.label: Specific Geography
values.definition: Restricted to a named geographic area.

values.label: Specific Time Period
values.definition: Restricted to use within a defined time period.

values.label: Specific Budget
values.definition: Restricted to a specific approved budget.

values.label: Specific Cost Category
values.definition: Restricted to a specific cost category (e.g. personnel, equipment).

values.label: Capital Only
values.definition: Restricted to capital expenditures.

values.label: Equipment Only
values.definition: Restricted to equipment purchases.

values.label: Endowment
values.definition: Restricted to an endowment fund.

values.label: Scholarship
values.definition: Restricted to scholarship purposes.

values.label: Regranting
values.definition: Restricted to redistribution as regrants.

values.label: Subgranting
values.definition: Restricted to redistribution as subgrants.

values.label: Lobbying
values.definition: Concerns lobbying activity, typically as a prohibited use.

values.label: Political Campaign Activity
values.definition: Concerns political campaign activity, typically as a prohibited use.

values.label: Voter Registration
values.definition: Concerns voter registration activity.

values.label: Noncharitable Purpose
values.definition: Concerns use for a noncharitable purpose, typically as a prohibited use.

values.label: Individual Benefit
values.definition: Concerns benefit to a specific individual, typically as a prohibited use.

values.label: Other
values.definition: A use restriction not captured by another value in this scheme.
